turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm putting together music for my friend's going away party and I have a few ideas.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is a playlist of all the songs from our college years, really nostalgic.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is hiring a local band that plays covers, but that eats up half the budget.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could ask a friend who does DJ sets on weekends, he'd do it for free if we feed him.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: How big is the party? For a small group, the nostalgic playlist is perfect. For a bigger crowd, I'd ask your DJ friend and give him the college songs as a request list.
